name: Drazel, Instructor of the Blade
flavor: Drazel found himself gifted with a blade. Upon graduation he chose to share that knowledge with the new recruits. When war came his unit was decimated, and Drazel joined the mercenaries to get stronger and make some money.
text: Drazel chose to halt his study of Defense and put it all into Attack. His Defense is 1000 when summoned, or equal to the Defense of the unit he promotes.

name: Galent, The Unbreakable Shield
text: His Attack is 1000 when summoned, or equal to the Attack of the unit he promotes.

name: Sena, Mistress of the shadows
summonEffect: Pickpocket: when summoned Sena can distroy 1 Item, artifact or equipment on the opponents side of the field, does not need to be in a formation and only activates when summoned.
text: Pickpocket: when Sena is summoned, you may destroy 1 Item, Artifact or Equipment on your opponent's side of the field. She doesn't need to be in a Formation.

name: Frontal Assault
text: Needs units in all three front-row slots. Attack and Defense are the sums of those three units.

name: Vanguard Charge
text: Needs units in all three front-row slots and the middle-centre slot. Attack is the sum of their Attack times 1.5, and Defense is the sum of their Defense divided by 1.5, rounded down.

name: Arms Academy
text: In your Preparation Phase I, you may enroll a Student of Arms from your hand by paying its Grade in Energy (up to 2 at a time). Two of your turns later, in your Preparation Phase I, summon a Graduate of Arms from your hand or deck to an empty slot at no cost, then send the Student of Arms to the Grave. If you took it from your deck, shuffle your deck. While this card is in play, you can promote any number of your Arms units on the field each turn, as long as you have the Energy.

name: Practice Gear
text: Equip to an Arms unit of Grade 1 to 3. The equipped unit gets +250 Attack and +250 Defense. If the unit is promoted to Grade 4 or higher, put this card in the Grave.

name: Drazel's Katana
text: Equip to Drazel, Instructor of the Blade only. He gets +500 Attack. Drazel does not conform to slaying the weak: while he is in your attacking Formation and its attack lands, the opponent's unit destroyed is the one with the highest Attack plus Defense.

name: Stand Strong
text: Set in an empty Unit Position Slot during your Preparation Phase I or II. During your opponent's Battle Phase, when one of your units would be destroyed, send this card to the Grave instead.

name: Blinding Beacon
text: Attach to one of your units in Preparation Phase I or II. Only one Blinding Beacon can be in your Formation. Holds 2 charges. When you attack, you may activate it: your opponent's Formation is deactivated for this Battle Phase and reactivates at the start of their turn. Two-turn cooldown. After its second activation, send it to the Grave.

name: Line Defense
text: Needs one full row: front, middle or back. Only that row counts. Attack is 0, and Defense is the sum of that row's units' Attack and Defense. Damage Grade 0: this Formation can't attack unless a card or effect raises its Damage Grade.

name: Fire Arrow
text: Cast in Preparation Phase I or II, or set it face-down in an empty unit slot. A set Fire Arrow can be activated in your Start, Preparation I, Battle, Preparation II or End Phase. Deals 1 Damage Counter to your opponent.
